create_dac_feature_extractor: create a DacFeatureExtractor instance with custom feature_size, sampling_rate, padding_value, and hop_length parameters
featurize_raw_audio: featurize raw audio numpy arrays or lists into padded BatchFeature tensors for the DAC model
pad_audio_sequences: pad audio sequences to the hop_length multiple with configurable padding strategy and max_length
validate_audio_input_shape: validate mono audio input shape and raise errors for unsupported stereo or multi-dimensional inputs
convert_to_return_tensors: convert padded audio inputs to PyTorch or NumPy tensors via the return_tensors parameter
